顾承安从衣服内侧口袋里摸出督察证件，递过去。

“看一下这个。”

能警官伸手接过，翻开封面。

他的表情变化很细微——先是疑惑，然后是确认，最后整个人的姿态都变了，脊背又挺直了几分。

虽然他自己是三级警督，证件上显示对方只是二级警司，级别还没他高。但他看的不是级别。

是证件的类别，这点他还是懂得起的。

能警官合上证件，立正，敬了礼。

“您好，我需要查验一下真伪，请理解。”

“你请便。”顾承安抬了下下巴，顺便提醒了下，“在警务通里输我的编号。”

能警官掏出手机，打开警务通，输入证件上的编号。

页面加载。

信息弹出来。

内容不多，很简略，但每一条都对得上——姓名、警号、照片、所属单位，其他就没了，全是＊号，并且还有友情提示。

在单位那一栏，能警官多看了两眼。

他立刻将证件双手递回。

“顾警官您好，非常抱歉。但我们目前正在执行公务，您的车辆确实存在违反规定的情况，还请理解。”

态度很诚恳，但立场也很明确。

该查还是得查。

顾承安没有不高兴。

相反，他在心里给能警官点了个赞——这人确实认真负责，不因为亮了个证件就立马放行，该走程序走程序，难怪网上口碑那么好。

但他还有东西没亮出来。

顾承安侧身探向中控储物箱，借着身体遮挡的角度，从系统空间取出特种车辆行驶证。

“能警官，我把车再往里挪一挪。”

他打着方向，轻踩油门，倒车，稳稳地停到了后边那辆警车正前方——两车头尾几乎贴在一起，缝隙不到两厘米。

这个位置，后面车辆里的人是看不到车牌了。

他按下了仪表台边角的那个按钮。

咔嗒。

一声极轻的机械转动。

然后他把特种车辆行驶证递给能警官。

Gu Chengan took out his inspector's ID card from the inner pocket of his clothes and handed it over.

"Take a look at this."

Officer Noh reached out and took it, flipping open the cover.

His expression changed very slightly—first confusion, then confirmation, and finally his entire posture changed, and his back straightened a bit.

Although he himself was a third-level police inspector, his ID showed that the other party was only a second-level police superintendent, which was not as high as him.But it’s not the level he’s looking at.

It's the type of certificate, which he can still understand.

Officer Noh closed his ID card, stood at attention, and saluted.

"Hello, I need to check the authenticity, please understand."

"Please do it." Gu Chengan raised his chin and reminded him, "Enter my number in the police account."

Officer Neng took out his mobile phone, opened the police app, and entered the number on his ID card.

The page loads.

A message pops up.

There is not much content, it is very simple, but every item is correct - name, police number, photo, affiliation, nothing else, it is all *, and there are friendly reminders.

At the unit column, Officer Noh took a second look.

He immediately handed the certificate back with both hands.

"Hello, Officer Gu, I'm very sorry. But we are currently performing official duties, and your vehicle does violate regulations. Please understand."

The attitude is sincere, but the position is also clear.

It still needs to be checked.

Gu Chengan was not unhappy.

On the contrary, he gave Officer Neng a thumbs up in his heart - this person is really serious and responsible. He will not let people go immediately just because he shows his ID. He should follow the procedures and follow the procedures. No wonder his online reputation is so good.

But there was something he hadn't shown yet.

Gu Chengan leaned sideways towards the central storage box and took out the special vehicle driving license from the system space using the angle of his body.

"Officer, I'll move the car further in."

He set the direction, lightly stepped on the accelerator, reversed, and stopped steadily right in front of the police car behind him - the front and rear of the two cars were almost touching, with a gap of less than two centimeters.

In this position, people in the vehicle behind cannot see the license plate.

He pressed the button on the corner of the dashboard.

Click.

There was a very light mechanical rotation.

Then he handed the special vehicle license to Officer Noh.
